digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution and verifier configuration
propositions: Three independent code paths that select verifier models all break when non-default providers are configured, silently downgrades to frontier instead of the configured standard class.

Equality-based model selection (comparing cfg.model against DEFAULT_MODEL) fails when models are provider-qualified (e.g. bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 vs bare claude-sonnet-4-6), making the rule unintentionally permeable to provider changes.
Code-review.yaml's verify step declares no model: key and temperature: 0 but runs on cfg.model (frontier), so determinism configuration never takes effect.

The fix centralizes reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) in a single resolve_model_string() function called at all four verifier sites to consistently resolve class names via configured slots instead of equality tests.
Backward compatibility requires literal model ids to pass through resolve_model_string() unchanged so existing workflow YAML continues to resolve byte-for-byte.
